name: Escape From Asylum
summary:
Trapped in the Dark. No Weapons. Only Your Wits.

You awaken inside the freezing, pitch-black corridors of an abandoned mental facility with zero memory of your identity. In Escape from Asylum, brute force will not save you—your survival relies entirely on observation, logic, and keeping your composure under intense psychological VR horror.

Step into a gripping survival puzzle adventure built from the ground up to test your deduction skills in room-scale Virtual Reality.
